rooms.name: room_default
rooms.description: You are floating in nothing.

rooms.name: room_limbo
rooms.description:
This strange room seems to have no substance at all, there are no walls,
no floor and no ceiling and there even seems to be a complete lack of air. 
It is as if the room is totally barren of everything, except yourself.

rooms.name: room_chat_lobby
rooms.description:
An orchestra of birds chirps in unison, their song carrying on throughout
a closed off area of life.  At the center, a small rabbit conducts while
squirrels and chipmunks dance, offering their happy voices to the show.  For
the moment, enemies become companions.  No fox chases any bird, no bird eats
any worm.  It is the epitome of the life cycle.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_MYSTICA
rooms.description:
As you step into this room, natural light fails you all together and you
rely totally on your light source or natural abilities to see.  Around you
is scattered debris, loose rubble and other remnants of what used to be a
grand foyer, all that is left now is a haunting feeling of deeds done in
that past.  Another sign of stone is here.

extra_descrs.description:
It says:
 
LISTEN TO ME! GO NO FURTHER!

rooms.name: room_begin_remort
rooms.description:
As you draw in your very first breath, you realize that the swirling mist
of colors and sounds, among other visions, has coalesced into what appears
to be a small, cluttered room.  Very old and rustic, all around you are
clocks of every size, type, and shape, all perfectly synchronized to the
second.  There are four windows on the four walls of the room from which you
can see everything.

extra_descrs.description:
Each of the four windows in this small room look out to the vast world of
Sentience.  Through one you can see a peaceful land filled with lustrous
mountains and blue skies; through another a grim world of desert and ashes. 
One shows you a sight of a place of shadows and mists, hard to distinguish,
and the last shows two huge continents floating in a wide expanse of ocean.

rooms.name: room_newbie_repop
rooms.description:
This is a rather large entrance chamber to the dungeon of Alendith.  It
was built by Alendith as a small proving grounds for novice adventurers to
practice their skills of battle and cunning.  There is a soft, dim light
coming from the various sconces and torches that light this place giving it
a dungeon-like feeling.

rooms.name: room_death
rooms.description:
This place is widely known as the entrance to the Netherworld.  An
endless drop into a large hole cut into the ground blows cold air upward. 
This is the gate through which all souls pass from life, into death.  It is
affectionately known as the "death hole".

rooms.name: room_war_staging
rooms.description:
This shady, low-ceilinged room is a shack with no apparent exit.  Battle
equipment lies all over the place - suits of heavy armour and chainmail are
set up in racks along the walls, and swords, spears, bows and axes are
everywhere to be seen.  A few crude wooden benches are propped up against a
wall and a well full of clean water is in the center of the room.

rooms.name: room_default_arena
rooms.description:
You are near the middle of the clearing.  The sunlight sparkles off fresh
dew that as formed in amongst the grass.  You see hints of a sign burnt into
the grass to the south.

rooms.name: room_defualt_altar
rooms.description:
Located in the north-west of Plith, this room is ancient, so old that it
is difficult to even estimate when it was created.  On the ground is a
pulsating mushroom, a unique fungus found nowhere else in the entire
megacosm.  A whispering noise seems to settle in the room, however there is
no movement of air at all, as if the sound were some mystical force.  Runes
stream across the north wall from left to right, glowing with an unknown
magic.

extra_descrs.description:
Argyle Evenhand, master of being and essential essence spoke his last,
broken words to the selected, as his life force faded into the dark never
known as death: "The rational mind is a feeble attempt at defining another
man's existence.  Once the path of analysis is taken, there is no turning
back, and only the strongest can affect the static directional pull of
normality.  The attempt at definition of form and function is totally
futile, like a dying child clawing vainly at the misty window of wisdom,
fingers sliding across the smooth surface.  It is a place we all go, but a
place we should never have thought to go.  The journey is an unavoidable
mistake explained by many as 'the condition of living'.  Soon though, there
will be one, and then many who take the thought, and by some unwordly means,
discard it, deviating from the path and forging a new consciousness.  Time
will reveal the truth, and chaos will begin."

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_EVIL
rooms.description:
In this room is an altar made of pure black marble, upon which are
several engravings.  A dagger sits on top of the altar, wrough from not only
iron but the power of Malice.  Various inscriptions and runes are engraved
on the walls and on the altar itself, reflecting the power of the Gods.  A
notice is nailed to the wall.

extra_descrs.description:
Official Memorandum:
 
Rule #1: Learn the rules so that you may break them properly.
 
(In fine print): The Church of Evil denies any association with
wrongdoing ahead of time. Smoking, drinking, and debauchery are
promoted but not insofar regarded as beneficial to one's health.
Copyright 93 S.S.Y.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GOOD
rooms.description:
This is a small room with an altar dedicated to Whisp, the god of the
Pious.  Many symbols of the Pious decorate the altar, all painted in strange
silver runes that seem to glow with magical power.  A formidable shield
rests upon the altar, for the taking of the rightful follower of the Pious. 
A sheet of parchment catches your eye as it floats to the ground.

extra_descrs.description:
It says:
 
Thy first lesson is to get us closer to the gates of Malice, so that we
may burn them down.

rooms.name: room_donation
rooms.description:
You are in a large well furnished stone room.  The roof of the room is
shaped in a funnel, that spouts light from a shimmering purple rift.  The
walls of the room are furnished in fine tapestries and shelves holding
ornaments from around the world.  Directly beneath the portal is a huge
exotic rug holding an assortment of objects piled on top of each other.  
A large sign{x is nailed to the wall.

extra_descrs.description: "Feel free to take any of these previously loved items." - Plith Donation Committee

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_PLITH_AIRSHIP
rooms.description:
A rather large platform, spanning twenty-five to thirty meters both
directions.  Ample space is needed for the airship to land here properly. 
The perimeter is lined with a heavy duty guard rail to prevent people from
falling off.  Four torches, one at each corner, burn vigilantly into even
the darkest of nights.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_SAILING_BOAT_HELM
rooms.description:
This is the helm and main deck of the sailing boat.  The decks are
freshly scrubbed and shine radiantly.  Above you, the large white sails
flutter in the wind.

rooms.name: room_sailing_boat_nest
rooms.description:
You are in the birds nest of the sailing boat.  You stand on a small
wooden platform just above the main sail.  It is cold and windy up here.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_SAILING_BOAT_STERN
rooms.description: Bootstrap placeholder room for reserved entity ROOM_VNUM_SAILING_BOAT_STERN.\n\r

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_CARGO_SHIP_HELM
rooms.description:
Attached to the tall, wooden mast of the ship is the helm.  The deck of
the ship is cluttered, with coils of rope and other assorted supplies lying,
ready to be grabbed. Nearby, there is a door swinging up from the deck
floor, leading down below.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_CARGO_SHIP_NEST
rooms.description:
Atop the mast of the ship, underneath the flag fluttering in the breeze,
is a small compartment. Standing in this "nest" of the ship, a view of the
massive ocean is visible in all directions. A salty-scented ocean breeze
whips around, and in the distance, a seagull calls.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_CARGO_SHIP_BOW
rooms.description:
The front of this small vessel comes to a point here, with a small
handrail around the edge to keep the curious from tumbling overboard.
Standing at this point, the ocean before the ship can be seen clearly to the
horizon.  Every so often, a wily wave of salt water splashes up to coat the
wooden deck.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_CARGO_SHIP_STERN
rooms.description:
Like the rest of the ship, the back is plain and completely ordinary. 
Neglected for more important tasks and slighty dingy, this area smells
faintly of mildew and is home to stray strands of seaweed and assorted
garbage.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_CARGO_SHIP_CARGO
rooms.description:
Beneath the deck of the ship, the cargo hold is dark with only a block of
light falling from the trapdoor. Wooden crates of cargo line the walls, and
faint sounds of insects skittering across the floor and sea rats squeaking
can be heard.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_AIR_SHIP_HELM
rooms.description:
This crudely attached wooden box appears to be the main control point of
this strange contraption.  Large levers jut out in all directions.  A furry
chair is bolted to the floor with a small lever in front of it.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_AIR_SHIP_DECK
rooms.description:
The inside of this strange contraption is definitely not made for
comfort.  The walls are solid metal with small slits wide enough to see out.
Small goblin sized seats have been roughly nailed to the corrigated
flooring.  A faint smell of vomit lingers.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_NEST
rooms.description:
Here, there is a comfortable compartment to stand in and oversee the
ship's destination.  High above the top of the ship, an eagle eye's view of
the ocean is visible.  Sounds of the action on the ship's deck below sound
faint and distant, as the sounds of the wind blowing and the birds calling
overpower them.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_HELM
rooms.description:
In the center of the ship, the captain can find the helm to this powerful
vessel.  Looking down to the sides, the bustling main deck can be seen, as
well as the menacing cannons protruding from the ships sides.  A nearby
ladder leads down to the cabin on the main deck.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_DECK
rooms.description:
Atop the cabin of the ship, this deck provides a view of not only the
surrounding sea, but the lower deck as well, giving a captain the ability to
survey all the action below.  The wooden deck is clean and in beautiful
condition, unmarred by splashing waves and trodding feet.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_CABIN
rooms.description:
A small cabin sits on the main deck of the ship, providing shelter and
workspace for the captain to use.  Against one wall is a place to get
well-needed rest; against the other, a table sits with navigational tools
and maps strewn about.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_BOW
rooms.description:
Jutting from the prow of this fine fighting ship is a frightening
replication of a sea dragon, mouth open in an eternally silent roar of
power. The front of the ship cuts through the water silently, spraying a
fine mist up in the air which occasionally moistens those standing here.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_STERN
rooms.description:
The stern of this proud warship merits no special attention, but serves
its purpose with clean, simple sophistication. Beauty is not sought here,
yet the area is not neglected. Simply standing here and watching the objects
in the horizon growing smaller and smaller is enough to make even the most
casual passenger swell with pride.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_FRIGATE_CARGO
rooms.description:
Underneath the decks of the ship, there is a large expanse of dark
storage area. Ammunitions and needed supplies are kept in large wooden
crates stacked around. There is a faint metallic scent in the air, as well
as the odor of musty wood.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_NEST
rooms.description:
The flag of the ship pounds proudly in the breeze, attached to the
highest point of the tremendous mast of the ship.  Also attached is this
compartment, providing a view over the ship and of the ocean all around. 
The highest point humanly accessible on this ship, the nest of the galleon
is the prime spot for scanning the horizons.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_HELM
rooms.description:
Here is the helm of the ship -- yet it seems awfully small to control a
ship as massive as this.  There are steps leading down into the lower parts
of the ship, and a large upper deck surrounds the mast.  Looking down, this
upper part of the ship provides a view of the goings on below.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_DECK
rooms.description:
Providing sanctuary from the busy workings of the ship, this comfortable
upper deck gives a beautiful view of the surrounding ocean. Benches around
the edge give a nice place to sit and socialize, relax, or just enjoy the
scenery.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_CABIN
rooms.description:
Pristinely clean and designed for comfort, this large room is perfect for
catching up on rest, making plans, or escaping the weather of the sea.
State-of-the-art navigational tools lay on a large desk, with maps and other
scrolls in neat, tidy order; on the other side of the room is a large,
comfortable bed for the captain.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_BOW
rooms.description:
A fine, shining brass handle lines the edge of the ship, keeping
travellers from falling overboard. Below, a graceful mermaid emerges from
the wooden prow of the ship, with a soft, dreamy expression on her lovely
face.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_STERN
rooms.description:
The fine, glimmering brass handle continues around the back of the ship,
a quiet retreat in itself from the massiveness of the ship.  The silence
here is only broken by the sounds of the ocean waves being broken and the
vibration of the oars thrumming through the entirety of the ship.  The
majesty of the sea and the majesty of the vessel melt into each other
here...  Beautiful.

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_CARGO
rooms.description:
Smelling faintly of wood and sea water, this room holds the normal cargo
of a ship.  Quite ordinary, wooden crates are stacked neatly around the
otherwise plain room. Perhaps there is some more interesting cargo somewhere
else...

rooms.name: ROOM_VNUM_GALLEON_TREASURE
rooms.description:
Glittering and beautiful, this room holds the special cargo of the ship:
the stored-up treasure.  Untouched by filth and grime, this room is clean
and sparkling.  Even the wood of the ship itself seems to glow a little bit
brighter here.

mobiles.name: mob death
mobiles.description:
In front of you stands Death himself.  Death wears a pitch black cloak
that covers his entire body.  His long black hood droops over his face,
covering any features from you.  His hands are all but skeletal bones,
clutched around a large shiny scythe.

mobiles.name: mob objcaster
mobiles.description:
This mobile is used as a dummy for implementing object casting - it is
loaded, cast the spell, then extracted.  Do not touch this.

mobiles.name: vnum questor 1
mobiles.description:
This is Lord Roscharch of Olaria, dressed in fine blue robes that attract
attention.  He is usually here most or even all of the day, buried under a
mountain of parchment and performing the bureaucratic duty of running the
town's finances and managing its industries.  Despite his seemingly mundane
persona, he settled down to a quiet life after many years of adventuring in
the dungeons, forests, and mountains of the continent. Now retired, he
delegates these tasks to brave adventurers interested in proving themselves,
even offering up some of his very valuable magical treasures in exchange for
enough help.

mobiles.name: mob neutral soultaker
mobiles.description:
The Mayor has no time for small, insignificant matters like a clean
household or a family.  His beard has grown down to his chest and his long
graying hair is disheveled.  Despite all this, he is anything but stressed,
and is happy having served the people of Plith for more than a decade.

mobiles.name: mob evil soultaker
mobiles.description:
This horrid fiend is evil and powerful.  He is an undead human of immense
magical ability, and if motivated, will send you screaming to the depths of
hell.  His reputation is immense, with bards all across the lands of
Sentience singing about his blackness.

mobiles.name: mob good soultaker
mobiles.description:
The bastion of peace and justice, and all-round good guy Sir Albert
Steiner sits mounted upon his trusty steed, 'Burt'.  Together they are the
most revered and respected duo in all of Plith.  Whether it be the tale of
him fighting the one eyed giant purple mutant rat while stuck to a kitchen
bench with a broken arm and a rubber spoon, or the time he single handedly
saved Plith from the plague of beavers in the year of the Jackal, his legend
lives strong in the souls of all the citizens of Plith as the mighty man
with the mighty horse.

mobiles.name: mob shifted changeling
mobiles.description:
This creature was once a slayer of all that is evil.  Taking on a larger
form and through grueling training, it has achieved a new essence.  Rather
than being against all that is evil, this creature has the free will to
decide what is evil and recognizes that within the wicked, there can be some
good.  Also, the changeling can see the evil that lies within those who bide
their time.  This is indeed a wise creature.

mobiles.name: mob vnum sailor diseased
mobiles.description:
The sailor is short fat and stumpy.  He gos about his daily chores on the
boat.  He looks rather diseased, and although a competent deck scrubber, is
not likely to put up a very good fight.

mobiles.name: mob vnum sailor dirty
mobiles.description:
The sailor looks rather dirty, but quite competent at his work.  He
whistles a sea shanty.

mobiles.name: mob sailor burly
mobiles.description:
The sailor is a big man.  He looks unshaven, but competent at performing
almost any of the vessel operations.

mobiles.name: mob vnum sailor trained
mobiles.description:
The sailor wears a neat uniform.  He looks trained and competent in
performing any vessel operation.

mobiles.name: mob vnum sailor mercenary
mobiles.description:
The sailor looks in good health and carries many tattoos.  You identify
the tattoos as famous pirate ships.  This sailor is not one to be messed
with and definitely competent at any task.

mobiles.name: mob vnum sailor elite
mobiles.description:
This sailor is an ex-navy troop.  This is displayed through the gold
emblazed tattoo on his arm.

mobiles.name: vnum questor 2
mobiles.description:
King Alemnos is rather aged, and is known as being a wise and venerable
king.  He has an extremely long white beard that still has remnants of his
once blonde hair.  He wears a royal robe dyed with a deep rich blue and
trimmed with white foxfur.  Sitting atop his mighty throne in Alcheor
castle, he is the true savior of the people, who all love and cherish him as
their king.  The King's feet sit right at eye level, keeping his entire body
elevated above all others'.  He is known to give quests to adventurers who
seek fame and reward.

mobiles.name: mob vnum geldoff
mobiles.description:
The man wears a finely made purple cowl that has seen many a long day
through.  Small gold pices of material have been cut out in the shape of
stars and moons and sewn to a floppy hat in the shape of a cone.  The old
man looks incredibly frail and looks as if he might trip over his long white
beard any second.  His arms and legs are shackled together.  You know this
man from myth and legend, his name is Geldoff.  It was said that Geldoff was
a kind and benevolent wizard who blew himself up by mistake.  His power was
so great that his soul was transferred to another body.  The gods were most
annoyed about this so they shackled him and stuck him here.  After 1000
years of walking around in circles, he is now a complete nutter.

This silver coin seems carelessly discarded.  Picking it up seems like
the right thing to do!

objects.name: obj vnum newb quarterstaff
objects.description:
This is a slender long quarterstaff.  Staves are the weapon of choice for
introductory students of magic and of the healing arts as they don't
participate as much in melee fighting as in their magical talents.  This
particular staff is made out of sturdy oak and slightly under two meters in
length.  A grey band of cloth with a black runic "S" painted on it has been
tied tightly about one end.

objects.name: obj vnum newb dagger
objects.description:
This is a sturdy iron dagger about two handsbreaths in length.  Its hilt
is grey with a dark black "S" painted on, flush near the pommel.  Daggers
such as this one are favored by thieves as an instrument of crafty attack
but are often carried by almost anyone on an adventuring trip.

objects.name: obj vnum newb sword
objects.description:
This is a steel sword whose blade is about three-quarters of a meter in
length.  Its edge is keen and straight, obviously good smith-work but
nothing spectacular.  It is just about the right weight and strength to be
used both for light sparring and as a real weapon.  The runic "S" protrudes
from the hilt in dark black wire metal.

objects.name: obj vnum newb armour
objects.description:
This leather armor is sturdy and light.  Although it won't serve to
protect very well against magic or heavy weaponry, it definitely provides a
layer of protection against light missiles and the usual cuts and scrapes
one might suffer on a long journey.  Across the chest a runic "S" has been
painted in dark black ink.

objects.name: obj vnum newb cloak
objects.description:
This simple brown cloak has been woven from hemp fiber, which provides
four times as much warmth as one woven from simple cotton - both durable and
economical.  It has a dark brown tint to it, obviously made to blend in with
the surroundings of a dark cavern or forest.  The clasp is in the shape of a
runic "S".

objects.name: obj vnum newb leggings
objects.description:
These leggings are lightweight and made out of strong leather.  They are
constructed to provide support, warmth, and protection to explorers on long
trips.  They are, however, quite simply made and bear no magical powers. 
Upon each kneecap a black runic "S" has been painted with ink.

objects.name: obj vnum newb boots
objects.description:
This is a pair of simple leather boots.  They are sturdy and stretch to
comfortably fit almost any man, woman or creature; leather thongs upon each
boot strap them sturdily to the wearer's feet.  They seem rather shabbily
made but will do for a little while.  A black runic "S" stands out on the
heel of each boot.

objects.name: obj vnum newb helm
objects.description:
This is a helmet forged from lightweight steel, held together at the
edges by rivets.  It looks to have been modeled after a knight's helmet,
with a visor to protect the eyes and a bright red plume topping it off. 
From the looks of it, it will take some wear and tear to grind down the
defensive value of this helmet. A black runic "S" has been painted on its
back.

objects.name: obj vnum newb harmonica
objects.description:
This harmonica is rather simple.  In fact, it appears to be made out of a
comb and a sheet of sandy rough paper.  These are often used by begginer
bards because they are cheap to make - after all, haircombs aren't widely
used for anything else in the warrior profession (cough), but they do make a
nice tune.

objects.name: obj vnum shackles
objects.description:
The shackles are made of iron and covered in thick red rust.  The
shackles themselves look crude but enough to keep you from breaking free of
them.  What could you have done to deserve this!?  (Not counting all those
hundreds of innocent creatures you murdered)

objects.name: obj vnum death book
objects.description:
This is not exactly the book of the dead, but more the book for the dead.
You have probably just met that lovable character known to all as Death. 
Currently you are cactus.  You have snuffed it.  This may have been by
another player or by a monster.  Really it doesn't matter, you are doomed to
walk around the realm of the dead known to all as the Netherworld.  Although
a rather gloomy place, there are some things to do, such as talk with other
players that have snuffed it, or have an explore.

Do not worry that your equipment has disappeared, for it will be back
again when you come back to life.  That is if you didn't die in a Chaotic
Player Killing Room.  Yes thats right, you come back to life.  The
Netherworld isn't big enough for everyone, so the gods will take pity on
your lifeless soul after five minutes from your death.  You may find a way
out of the Netherworld and explore other places in the world, however you
are only a shadow of yourself and therefore can't attack creatures or pick
up objects.

objects.name: obj empty vial
objects.description:
This is a small empty glass vial used to prepare magical potions.  The
thick tempered glass prevents it from being broken easily but doesn't
protect it from fire or magical energy.  A blank white label is on the side
of the vial so to make sure they don't get mixed up.  Those with the
knowledge of alchemy often take many of these onto any adventure as they
prove to be very useful.

objects.name: obj potion
objects.description: A potion of %s lies here.

objects.name: obj blank scroll
objects.description:
This is a sheet of crisp yellow papyrus rolled up into a scroll.  A thin
strip of silver ink runs down both sides, reflecting light.  A watermark
shows through the paper as rays of light strike it, proving it to be an
authentic scroll proper to be used for scribing magic spells.  Each one can
be invested with the power of up to three spells, and lasts almost
indefinitely.

objects.name: obj vnum relic extra damage
objects.description:
This huge relic of stone and mortar is in the shape of a large eye
protruding from a pentagram.  A ruby stone is placed at each of the five
points of it and each stone casts a blue light that creates pulsating lines
of power to the other ends.  The eye in the center pulsates, providing the
owners of this relic with pure energy.

objects.name: obj vnum relic extra xp
objects.description:
This relic is in the shape of a four-cornered diamond.  It is made of
cold stone and moss grows in between its cracks.  It emits a low humming
sound, and concentrating closer you can make out songs of the ancient world
- the experience of all who came before is stored in this mighty relic,
providing its wielders with access to knowledge most can only dream of.

objects.name: obj vnum relic extra pneuma
objects.description:
This relic is in the shape of a giant ankh made of cold black stone.  It
vibrates with energy from beyond the grave captured from eons of harvesting
the power of souls lost in transit.  Tiny green sparks float around the
relic, lighting the area around it with an eerie glow and making the air hum
with power.

objects.name: obj vnum relic hp regen
objects.description:
The Relic of Health is in the shape of an open hand made of stone.  A
soft glow protrudes from each of the fingers, and gives the air around it a
warm feeling.  In the presence of this holy object, you feel revitalized,
ready to taken on the whole world from its blessings.

objects.name: obj vnum relic mana regen
objects.description:
The Relic of Magic spawned from the sacred Tree which gave birth to the
entire existence of Sentience.  It is in the simple shape of a stone circle,
a line returning on itself, Bolts of white, green, red, and blue lightning
arc and dance across the inside of the circle, concentrating the relic's
magical powers into one strong source.

objects.name: obj vnum healing locket
objects.description:
This small silver locket is strung on a chain made to fit around the neck
of a human with a tiny clasp in the form of two snakes biting each other's
tails.  The locket itself is in the shape of a diamond, wrought from gold in
Macbeth's treasury; one of the diamond swings open on a tiny hinge in a side
corner, opening up.  Within it is a miniature card: the Queen of Spades.

objects.name: obj vnum starchart
objects.description:
This dusty theorem of the star-charts depict various geometric shapes and
astral alignments designed to make plane-travelling available to the common
man.  Most of the drawings are unintelligible to all but the professional
astronomer, but runes by each of the drawings show what to recite to get to
different places.  
 
Along the bottom of the papyrus you see:
{BPlith Olaria Reza Fort Aethilforge{X
 
A {RNOTE{X scribbled on the papyrus in blood protrudes and catches your
attention. It's obviously quite important.

objects.name: obj vnum argyle ring
objects.description:
The ring of Argyle Evenhand is a treasure unknown to most mortals.  It is
a simple circle of silver with the runic initials of the prophet himself on
it and has been lost for generations.  Rumors have been whispered that the
soul of the Argyle still lives on in his ring, aiding all those blessed by
the Gods.

objects.name: obj dragon shield
objects.description:
The Shield of the Dragon is made out of dragonscales and has a sparkling
golden finish.  The dragonscales are attached to a firm wooden frame with
tiny links of mithril chain and the shield sparkles even in the darkness. 
It is warm to the touch and is impervious to weather, heat, cold, and magic.
A strange, unmistakably powerful aura surrounds the shield as if there were
something special to it.

objects.name: obj vnum sword mishkal
objects.description:
The sword borne by the Warlock Mishkal, commander of demons and slayer of
everything holy, is before you.  The hilt of this sword has been fashioned
from the spine and vertebrae of a fallen Angel; five feathers taken from the
five Angel commanders who fell before Mishkal himself adorn the pommel,
stained with blood from countless slaying and sacrifices.  The pure black
blade has been fashioned from metal found only in the deepest fissure of the
Abyss, and glows a diabolical red in the center.

objects.name: obj golden apple
objects.description:
The skin of this apple rather than being red or green is a vibrant gold
and looks luscious.  A warm yellow light shines from it, gently irradiating
the air with magic as you hold it in your hand.  The tiny leaves near the
stem are golden as well and feather-soft to the touch.  This must indeed be
the food of the gods.

objects.name: obj vnum glass hammer
objects.description:
This tiny crystal hammer seems made for a faerie for it can be easily
grasped between the thumb and the forefinger.  The craftsmanship of it is
exquisite and you can't help but notice an aura of magic surrouding it and
flowing into your hand.  Near its handle is a tiny label with the words:
"Strike an item with me to renew it.  Beware, for my magic can be
used once only, so choose wisely."

objects.name: obj vnum pawn ticket
objects.description:
This shimmering silver ticket was once issued to one of the squires of
King Alemnos when he was short on cash and decided to steal and pawn the
King's exquisite royal sceptre.  Foolishly, he used the money to have one
too many an ale at the pub and told his story to the royal wizard, who
promptly incinerated him.  The wizard's wrath was so strong and his magic so
powerful that it enchanted the ticket he was holding, which was then brought
back to the King.  The King's Court realised the potent reaction of wizardry
with the brand of ale in stock at the pub yielded a magic which could allow
magical and martial students to practice their skills well beyond what they
could normally attain without experience.

objects.name: obj vnum cursed orb
objects.description:
The Orb of Shadows resembles a fluffy cloud and feels cold to the touch. 
It shimmers with a strange blue pattern so often that you can't quite make
out what it is.  It has been whispered that putting an item within this
cloud puts a powerful curse on it - a curse so powerful that the item can
never be removed from the user without divine intervention and the use of
arcane magics.

objects.name: obj vnum gold whistle
objects.description:
This tiny golden whistle reflects a sheen as it is turned around in the
light.  Speckles of green emerald dust reveal themselves embedded in the
material. It comes on a simple black cord to be fastened somewhere securely.
A subtle "A" is carved on the underside.  It is said this whistle has the
magical power to call forth animals instantly.

objects.name: obj black moonstone shard
objects.description:
The rock you hold appears to be a shard of fabled moonstone.  Black
moonstone is an alien to this world and said to originally be found within
the realm of Demos.  The realm of Demos is a cruel world alive with magic. 
It is said that the black moonstone is what provides magic to this world.

objects.name: obj vnum dark wraith eq
objects.description:
Used by ninja as part of their shinobi shozoku, this scarf wraps around
the head and neck, enshrouding it in a veil of shadow.  The dark silk feels
exotic, and smooth to the touch.  Light just seems to disappear when it
strikes it, causing it to grow darker as it falls into shadow.

objects.name: obj pneuma item
objects.description:
This is a small vial of misty blue glass.  From it the soul of an
imprisoned being is trapped.  It gives off a glowing blue light like a
lantern and is very soothing to look at.  The glass is made of perfectly
blown glass in the fiery depths of the Demon Realm, made for confining
souls.  The cork is magically sealed and can only be removed by one of three
beings in Seralia.
